conflicts.details_sharded_in: position-evidence records with a non-empty conflicts list

review_scope.note: Positions whose requirement text carries at least one review reason. Coverage is a catalog reference, never a full interpretation.

normalization_rules.rule: 专业要求写作“X门类”或“X学科门类”时，按 X 学科门类节点解析；不据此判定个人可报。

basis.title: 关于教育部2027年度公务员考录职位要求的说明
basis.applies_to: 教育部 2027 年度考录职位；其门类/一级学科包含语义为国内通行口径
basis.text: 职位专业要求为学科门类的，即该门类所包含的专业和一级学科均符合要求；专业要求为一级学科的，即该一级学科所包含的二级学科均符合要求。

normalization_rules.rule: 原文自带两位门类代码（如“经济学类（02）”）时，按该门类节点解析。

reason_taxonomy.major_text_unrestricted: 专业 column is exactly 不限/无限制/专业不限/不限专业
reason_taxonomy.no_explicit_code_in_major_column: no four-to-seven digit token in 专业
reason_taxonomy.institution_local_code: Z/J/S style code; suffix is assigned by the granting unit
reason_taxonomy.code_outside_education_scope: the code exists in the other education namespace only; levels are not merged and it is not counted as coverage
reason_taxonomy.code_unresolved_in_loaded_catalogs: code form recognized but no catalog node has it
reason_taxonomy.gate_code_name_mismatch: printed two-digit gate code disagrees with the name after it
reason_taxonomy.negative_or_exclusion_present: 专业 text contains an exclusion expression
reason_taxonomy.open_scope_or_qualifier: 专业 text contains 相关/等专业/方向/仅限 style wording
reason_taxonomy.degree_word_inside_single_clause: a degree word sits inside an undivided clause
reason_taxonomy.category_phrase_without_exact_catalog_no: text ends a phrase in 类 with no exact catalog node
reason_taxonomy.no_machine_readable_code_in_major_column: no code recovered from 专业
reason_taxonomy.no_machine_readable_code_in_remarks_colu: no code or exact name recovered from 备注
reason_taxonomy.name_exists_only_in_other_education_leve: a bare name has an exact catalog node only at a different education level, which is not treated as a match
reason_taxonomy.bachelor_category_name_in_graduate_posit: the text uses a bachelor category name in a graduate-only position; the graduate catalog has no node with that name
reason_taxonomy.colloquial_gate_name_with_类_suffix: a discipline-gate name written with a 类 suffix, e.g. 理学类; not an official category and not normalized
reason_taxonomy.agency_category_without_published_member: the agency uses an in-house category phrase such as 经济金融类 or 气象类 and publishes no membership list
reason_taxonomy.code_name_conflict: a printed name next to a code disagrees with the catalog name

field_semantics.备注: position remarks text, original string; telephone numbers, years and area codes are filtered out

cross_field_dedup: A position is counted once per complete code; both field origins are kept.

semantics.catalog_candidate: An exact code or exact catalog name was found in a compatible education namespace. This is not a full interpretation of the requirement and not an applicant eligibility result.
semantics.new_catalogs: The two graduate enrollment code books are the only public documents that enumerate six-digit graduate secondary codes; the 2026 self-set roster publishes names only and confers no code.
semantics.no_fuzzy_matching: Names match only exactly; 会计学类 is not treated as 会计学.
semantics.additivity: A position can carry several codes; code counts never sum to national totals.
